svg.title: Historical trend of top US baby names
svg.desc: Plot of historical rankings of top USA baby names according to the Social Security Administration by CMG Lee. Names listed have achieved top-5 rank, and names in bold have achieved top rank in at least one of the years shown. Names are ordered by ascending year they first appeared in the top-5 and then rank. Data is from http://www.ssa.gov/oact/babynames/limits.html .
